newsitem.title: USA: US CREDIT MARKET OUTLOOK - BULL RUN DECLARED DONE.
newsitem.headline: US CREDIT MARKET OUTLOOK - BULL RUN DECLARED DONE.

text.p: It had to end sooner or later, but U.S. government securities traders didn't expect the market's bull run to come to quite such an abrupt halt.
But, with prices down more than four points and yields up as much as 40 basis points in a week, that's what analysts said has occurred.
"We go back to establishing a trading range," said Michael Strauss, chief economist at Sanwa Securities (USA) Co.
"We were trading at ludicrious levels and Friday provided a wake-up call to the end of the bull market run."
